# AI Voice Agency
> The voice operations system for phone-driven revenue. AVA answers
> inbound calls, calls fresh leads back in seconds, qualifies, books,
> live-transfers hot leads to closers, and writes every call cleanly
> into your CRM. Custom-built, scoped before you pay.

## Primary
- [Homepage](https://aivoiceagency.ai/): Hero live-call widget (role chips + name + cell), capability grid (inbound, outbound speed-to-lead, live warm transfer, booking, CRM writeback, custom voices, 24/7 multilingual), pricing, FAQ, founder story
- [Pricing](https://aivoiceagency.ai/#pricing): Starter System (from $497/mo + setup, typical starting point), Growth System (from $997/mo + setup, typical starting point), Operations System (custom quoted), White Glove (apply only)
- [Operator Story](https://aivoiceagency.ai/#operator): Shane Handel, 30 years operating, 25 years phone-heavy operations

## Verticals
- [Professional Services](https://aivoiceagency.ai/professional-services): Law firms, accounting, agencies, consulting. New client intake, conflict screening, existing client routing, scheduling.
- [Home Services](https://aivoiceagency.ai/home-services): HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest control. Emergency dispatch, estimates, schedule changes, repeat customer routing. Works with ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, FieldEdge.
- [Medical Practices](https://aivoiceagency.ai/medical-practices): Dental, primary care, specialty, vet, chiropractic. Appointment scheduling, prescription routing, new patient intake, after-hours triage.
- [Ground Transportation](https://aivoiceagency.ai/ground-transportation): Limo, chauffeur, black car, sedan, sprinter, motorcoach, charter, NEMT, corporate accounts. Reservation intake, dispatch-aware answering, rate-sheet quoting, flight-status concierge, greeter instructions (AI captures, chauffeur delivers), CRM + dispatch writeback. Works with Limo Anywhere via Zapier, GoHighLevel, flight-data feeds.
- [Hospitality & Events](https://aivoiceagency.ai/hospitality): Hotels, restaurants, event venues, wedding planners. Reservations, event inquiries, vendor routing, front desk overflow.

## Wisconsin Cities (local SEO layer)
- [Milwaukee](https://aivoiceagency.ai/milwaukee): Greater Milwaukee metro — Third Ward, Bay View, Wauwatosa, Brookfield, Brady Street. Brewers/Bucks gameday surge ready.
- [Madison](https://aivoiceagency.ai/madison): State Street, East Side, Middleton, Verona, Sun Prairie. Epic-adjacent practices, legislative-cycle volume, gameday surge.
- [Green Bay](https://aivoiceagency.ai/green-bay): Ashwaubenon, De Pere, Allouez, Howard. Lambeau gameday volume, manufacturing-shift hours, smaller-market relationship business.
- [Wisconsin Limo](https://aivoiceagency.ai/wisconsin-limo): High-intent wedge for Wisconsin limo operators — The Crush math, TMC overflow handling, GNet affiliate routing, Wisconsin pronunciation lock.

## Capabilities (proof-safe)
- Inbound answering on the first ring, every time
- Outbound speed-to-lead — AVA calls fresh leads in seconds, while they still want to talk
- Live warm transfer — qualified hot leads handed straight to a closer (the warm handoff that beats the no-show)
- Booking and routing — appointments straight to your calendar, escalations to humans, VIP handling
- Missed-call recovery — instant text-back + callback before the lead calls a competitor
- CRM + workflow writeback — structured records into GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, calendars, inboxes
- Custom voices — any voice, any tone, any language, premium synthetic or your own cloned voice
- 24/7 multilingual coverage — switches language mid-call when the caller does
- Built for burst capacity, scoped to your call volume — no raw concurrency claim until validated
- Secure SIP / BYOC telephony, PII handling, post-call transcripts + summaries + QA

## Live demo
- Hero live-call widget — pick a role, drop your cell, AVA calls in seconds
- Roles supported: Receptionist, Outbound Sales Rep, Lead Qualifier, Appointment Setter, Customer Service, After-Hours / Overflow, Survey & Follow-up
- Ground transportation roles: Dispatcher, Reservation Agent, Quote & Rate Desk, Flight-Status Concierge, After-Hours Answering, Corporate Account Desk
